_comment: Local SSOT for the 'protect main (admin PAT bypass)' GitHub ruleset (id 20232367 on github.com/sh-ai-x/dev-harness-kit). PATCHed onto the live ruleset via `bin/ruleset-sync.sh` so the ruleset's `bypass_actors` block — which renders in the GitHub UI as the 'Allow specified actors to bypass required pull requests' checkbox list — is reproducible from the repo. Schema: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/rules#get-a-repository-ruleset
name: protect main (admin PAT bypass)

bypass_actors._comment: RepositoryRole ADMIN — the repo's owner(s). This is the entry that restores the 'admin bypass' checkbox; without it, admins are subject to the same required-status-checks as any other committer. version-bump.yml relies on this for `DEV_KIT_GITHUB_TOKEN` PAT pushes to bypass the ruleset (see .github/workflows/version-bump.yml:38-47 for the rationale).
RepositoryRole MAINTAIN — any maintainer can also bypass. Mirrors the GitHub UI checkbox list so an org maintainer is not gated by a single admin's availability.

RepositoryRole WRITE — write-role members (including dev-kit bots that push PR branches) get 'pull_request' bypass only, not 'always'. This keeps bot pushes to PR branches free of admin-level merge authority while still unblocking the version-bump PAT push path.
